sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: OCUN reports 25 sport crags, about 350 single-pitch sport routes and 70 multipitch routes; other bouldering sources report granite boulders.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: The sport climbing grade band reported by OCUN is concentrated around 5a to 7c, which supports beginner and intermediate roped climbers as well as boulderers.

claims.text: Maltatal is an Austrian alpine valley with both granite bouldering and roped climbing.
OCUN reports 25 sport crags, about 350 single-pitch sport routes and 70 multipitch routes; other bouldering sources report granite boulders.
The sport climbing grade band reported by OCUN is concentrated around 5a to 7c, which supports beginner and intermediate roped climbers as well as boulderers.
The sourced roped-climbing range is 5a to 7c; bouldering grades need a separate guidebook-backed pass before being normalized further.
Spring, summer and autumn are assigned because Maltatal is an alpine valley; altitude and weather should still be checked before travel.
The valley setting makes a car the conservative transport tag for moving between sectors.
